get.description: Implemented codes: audit-events, cash, count-variances, customer-custody, deposits, expenses, journal-lines, posted-sales, provider-intents, purchase-progress, recalls, receivables, returns, sales-lines, sales-register, stock, stock-movements, supplier-invoices, supplier-payables, tender-facts. Dates required for recalls, posted-sales, sales-register, cash, provider-intents, returns, expenses, purchase-progress, supplier-invoices, count-variances, journal-lines, audit-events and forbidden for customer-custody, supplier-payables, sales-lines, stock, receivables, deposits, stock-movements, tender-facts. All row cells and total values are exact strings. Totals cover all filtered rows on nonempty pages; empty pages have no totals. CSV exports one bounded page, with X-Report-Has-More indicating more rows.
